t2: Stored secrets (tokens, passwords you gave Launchway) are locked with a root key that lives outside the database. A copy of the database alone shows none of them. The other side of that: lose the key and they cannot be read, by anyone. So keep a recovery copy somewhere apart from your backups.

t6: Take a recovery copy of the root key
t7: Launchway asks for your password and a code again, because this is the key to everything. The copy is locked with a passphrase you choose (type it twice); Launchway keeps no copy and no passphrase, only a note that one was taken.
t8: The code from your authenticator app
t9: A passphrase for the copy (at least 12 characters)
t10: The two passphrases are not the same.
t11: The copy was downloaded as launchway-root-key-copy.json. Keep it, and the passphrase, somewhere other than the database's backups.
